description: This file provides test helpers for the absl::Cord class, including enumerations for different cord sizes, utility functions for creating fragmented cords, and string representations of sizes. It is used for testing Cord behavior with various string sizes and segmentations.

classes.name: TestCordSize
classes.description: Enumeration of different cord sizes used for testing, including empty, inlined, small, SSO, medium, and large sizes.

methods.name: MakeFragmentedCord
methods.description: Creates a multi-segment Cord from a container of strings, used for testing segmented Cord behavior.

methods.name: MakeFragmentedCord
methods.description: Overload that creates a multi-segment Cord from an initializer list of string views.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a TestCordSize enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size corresponding to a TestCordSize enum value.
